param: α₁ Recruitment rate into susceptible people A
α₂ Recruitment/entry rate into infected people P
ψ₁ Effective contact rate with infectious humans (drives A→P transmission via P)
ψ₂ Contact rate with Ebola virus pathogens in the environment (drives A→P via U)
ψ₃ Effective contact rate with deceased humans (drives A→P via S)
ε Natural death/removal rate of humans (applies to A,P,F,K in equations)
ρ₁ Disease-induced death rate of infected humans (contributes to S from P)
ρ₂ Shedding rate of infected humans into environment (P→U contribution)
ρ₃ Rate at which infected people are quarantined (P→F)
ω₁ Recovery rate of quarantined people (F→K contribution)
ω₂ Death rate in quarantine due to infection (contributes to S from F)
h Shedding rate from deceased people into environment (S→U contribution)
c Burial/removal rate of deceased people (removes S)
b Clearance/decay rate of Ebola virus pathogens in the environment (removes U)
d External input/source term into environment U
